requested_by: Author (user), 2026-11-12: bundle E of the review-round-5 revision plan, the alternative baseline (outer width of the door measured from its edges), to be done if time allowed. Written while the extension_v16 training queue was running.
seen_before_registration: All results of the learned detectors and of the registered template-matching baseline (extension_v16e: five-fold doors 190/361, temporal 11/133). Field images as shown in Fig. 1 and in the label and camera check sheets: the doors are bright sheet metal on a darker jig table, with clamps, louvres and tools near the edges. No output of any width measurement on any image.
principle: A classical measurement without hole detection and without point annotations: the outer width of the door from a brightness segmentation. Class labels of the TRAIN sessions calibrate it, as they calibrate the scale S of the hole method. Two decision variants are registered; nothing else is tried.

steps: gray image (1920 x 1200), Gaussian blur sigma 2
threshold T = k x Otsu threshold of the whole image; mask = gray > T
morphological closing with a square kernel of c x c pixels
for every image row between 25% and 75% of the component's bounding-box height: extent = last minus first component pixel in the row plus 1
W_px = median of the row extents
measurement.no_measurement: largest component smaller than 5% of the image area, or fewer than 20 rows in the band; the image is then rejected
measurement.unit: W_mm = 1450 x W_px / fx. 1,450 mm is the median depth distance of the door plane reported in manuscript v15, section 4.3; it only sets the unit in which the 30 mm rule is applied.

variant_B_class_reference_widths: PRIMARY (Table 3 row). Reference of a class = median over its TRAIN sessions of the session median W_mm. Image decision: nearest reference, rejected when farther than 30 mm. Door decision: the session vote of the manuscript (run_extension_v5.vote). A class without a TRAIN session has no reference.
variant_A_affine_map_to_cad: Least-squares line D = a x + b over the TRAIN sessions (x = session median of W_px / fx, y = CAD hole distance of the session's class). Image decision: nearest CAD value of the registered list to a x + b, rejected beyond 30 mm; session vote. No valid-distance-range check.
variant_A_unseen: Folds 0-4, each of the eight classes c removed: line fitted without the TRAIN sessions of c and candidate selected on the VAL sessions without c. TEST doors judged (i) with the seven-value CAD list (doors of c should be rejected; decisions of the other doors) and (ii) after adding D_c to the list with the same line (doors of c should be identified). Variant B cannot register a class without its images and has no such test.
selection: Per split and per variant: the candidate with the highest door accuracy on the VAL sessions (references or line from TRAIN); ties: higher VAL image accuracy, then the earlier candidate in the listed order. No TEST image or TEST label is used.

evaluation.splits: five folds (out-of-fold TEST doors, 361) and the temporal split (133 later doors); the partitions of the manuscript
evaluation.metrics: as Table 3: image accuracy and coverage, door accuracy with Wilson 95% interval; wrong and rejected doors by class; results before / after the camera change; doors on which the baseline and the learned field-adapted detector differ; class reference widths, their smallest gap and the spread of the session medians within a class; line coefficients and residual RMS of variant A; single-thread measurement time per image; the selected candidate per split and the VAL accuracy of every candidate

claim_rule: The result is reported whatever its direction. If a width baseline identifies the registered doors as well as the hole method, the manuscript states that a classical width measurement suffices for identification among registered classes in this jig and restates the contribution accordingly; if variant A also rejects and registers unseen classes, that is stated as well. No candidate, variant or rule is added or changed after a TEST result has been seen.
